variants.body: A red-bellied woodpecker is announcing themselves to the whole neighborhood.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is calling near {green}
variants.body: A loud rolling kwirr, then a flash of red cap and zebra stripes on a trunk.

variants.title: A woodpecker is stashing acorns in the bark
variants.body: Wedging nuts into cracks to eat later. A winter pantry, one acorn at a time.

variants.title: Red-bellied woodpecker, pantry manager
variants.body: Every crack in the bark is a cupboard right now.

variants.title: A woodpecker is filling a pantry near {green}
variants.body: Wedging acorns and nuts into bark cracks to snack on all winter.

variants.title: A woodpecker is raiding their own pantry
variants.body: Prying out the nuts they hid in the bark back in fall.

variants.title: A zebra-striped woodpecker is out in the cold
variants.body: Red cap bright against the gray, checking the bark for snacks.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is snacking near {green}
variants.body: Digging the nuts they hid in fall out of the bark, one by one.

variants.title: A titmouse is whistling peter, peter, peter
variants.body: Loud for such a small gray bird. Look for the pointy crest.

variants.title: Peter, peter, from the trees
variants.body: That's a tufted titmouse, the curious little boss of the treetops.

variants.title: A titmouse is whistling in the trees near {green}
variants.body: Peter, peter, peter, from a small gray bird with big dark eyes and a pointy crest.

variants.title: A titmouse is leading a mixed flock
variants.body: Chickadees, woodpeckers and kinglets follow along. Titmice are the lookouts.

variants.title: The little gray boss is in charge
variants.body: When the titmouse calls an alarm, the whole flock listens.

variants.title: A mixed flock is moving through {green}
variants.body: Led by a bossy little titmouse, with woodpeckers and other small birds tagging along.

variants.title: A titmouse is collecting soft nest lining
variants.body: Hair, fur, fluff. They've been known to pluck it from a sleeping raccoon.

variants.title: Titmouse on a fluff-gathering mission
variants.body: Every soft thing goes into the nest.

variants.title: A titmouse is gathering nest fluff near {green}
variants.body: Anything soft will do, even fur from a sleeping raccoon.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is flicking through the leaves
variants.body: Hop, pause, raise the tail slowly, lower it. They're shy and very gentle.

variants.title: A spotted bird is hiding on the ground
variants.body: Brown back, spotted chest, rusty tail lifting slowly. That's a hermit thrush.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is hopping through the leaves near {green}
variants.body: Quiet and shy, lifting their rusty tail slowly, picking bugs from the leaf litter.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is singing like a flute
variants.body: A clear note, then a spiral of echoing tones. One of the loveliest songs anywhere.

variants.title: Listen: a flute in the trees
variants.body: It's a hermit thrush passing through, singing a little before heading north.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is singing near {green}
variants.body: A clear, echoing, flute-like song, rising in spirals in the evening light.

variants.title: A hermit thrush stayed for winter
variants.body: Living on berries in a sheltered thicket, quietly getting by.

variants.title: A thrush is snacking on winter berries
variants.body: When the bugs are gone, berries keep them going.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is eating berries near {green}
variants.body: Tucked in a sheltered thicket, picking at the last winter berries.

variants.title: A butter butt is flitting through the trees
variants.body: Watch for the flash of yellow above the tail as they hop from branch to branch.

variants.title: Check, check, from the branches
variants.body: A yellow-rumped warbler is calling to their flock.

variants.title: Yellow-rumped warblers are flitting through the trees near {green}
variants.body: Little gray birds flashing yellow rumps, calling check! as they go.

variants.title: A warbler is eating waxy bayberries
variants.body: Their superpower: they can digest the wax, so they survive winters other warblers can't.

variants.title: A tough little warbler is staying for winter
variants.body: Most warblers fly south. This one stays and eats berries.

variants.title: Yellow-rumped warblers are eating berries near {water}
variants.body: Plucking waxy bayberries from the shrubs, one of the few warblers who winter here.

variants.title: Warblers are passing through in their spring colors
variants.body: Bright yellow, black and white. They'll be gone north in a few weeks.

variants.title: A wave of warblers is moving through
variants.body: Spring migration! Yellow-rumps are first to arrive and most common.

variants.title: Spring warblers are moving through {green}
variants.body: Yellow-rumps in their brightest colors, stopping to feed on their way north.
